attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and group inventory-readers (neither existed), chowned the tree recursively to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files so the owner has full access, the group can read, and other users have no access. Existing data (records.csv, config.json) was preserved and verified byte-identical via checksum before and after. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, permissions, checksums), issued a native reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed a new boot_id after recovery, and re-verified ownership, permissions, and data checksums plus persistence of the new user/group post-restart.
